title: Elastic Stack 8.19.24 released
summary: Read about the updates and bug fixes that have been included in this release.
body_markdown:
Version 8.19.24 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you[upgrade to this latest version](https://www.elastic.co/docs/deploy-manage/upgrade) . We recommend 8.19.24 over the previous versions 8.19.23


For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to[the release notes](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/starting-with-the-elasticsearch-platform-and-its-solutions/8.19/new.html) .


These releases contain security fixes. For details, refer to the Elastic Security Advisories at[https://discuss.elastic.co/c/announcements/security-announcements/31](https://discuss.elastic.co/c/announcements/security-announcements/31) .
